definitions.explanation: A level or grade between beginner and advanced. Used in education, language study, sports, and product classifications.

examples.japanese: {中級|ちゅうきゅう}クラスに{入|はい}った。
この{教科書|きょうかしょ}は{中級|ちゅうきゅう}{向|む}けです。
examples.english: This textbook is aimed at intermediate learners.

examples.japanese: {初級|しょきゅう}から{中級|ちゅうきゅう}に{上|あ}がるのが{一番|いちばん}{難|むずか}しいと{言|い}われている。
examples.english: It's said that moving from beginner to intermediate is the hardest part.

notes:
USAGE:
Part of the three-level system {初級|しょきゅう} (beginner) → {中級|ちゅうきゅう} (intermediate) → {上級|じょうきゅう} (advanced). Very commonly used in language learning contexts in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中級|ちゅうきゅう}{者|しゃ} (intermediate-level person)
- {中級|ちゅうきゅう}{編|へん} (intermediate volume/section)
- {中級|ちゅうきゅう}レベル (intermediate level)
- {中級|ちゅうきゅう}{向|む}け (aimed at intermediate learners)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {初級|しょきゅう}: beginner level
- {上級|じょうきゅう}: advanced level
